description: This file defines a 'Circle' class for rendering and managing interactive circle overlays on a Leaflet map within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, styling, and handling events for map circles, with support for labels and tooltips.

classes.name: Circle
classes.description: Represents a map circle with interactive features such as labels, tooltips, and event handling, used within the Thingsboard map widget.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Circle instance, creating a Leaflet circle overlay with specified settings, labels, and tooltips.

methods.name: createEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for dragging, editing, and clicking on the circle.

methods.name: updateLabel
methods.description: Updates the circle's label tooltip based on current data and settings.

methods.name: updateTooltip
methods.description: Updates the circle's tooltip content based on current data and settings.

methods.name: updateCircleColor
methods.description: Updates the fill and stroke color of the circle based on configured functions.

methods.name: updateCircle
methods.description: Refreshes the circle's position, radius, labels, tooltips, and styles based on new data.

methods.name: createCenterPosition
methods.description: Creates a new LatLng object for the circle's center based on current data.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Calculates the fill color for the circle, possibly using a function.

methods.name: getStrokeColor
methods.description: Calculates the stroke color for the circle, possibly using a function.
